title: To Hack or not to Hack
statementMd:
Consider a regular Codeforces round consisting of three problems that uses dynamic scoring.

You are given an almost final scoreboard. For each participant (including yourself), the time of the accepted submission for each of the problems is given. Also, for each solution you already know whether you are able to hack it or not. The only changes in the scoreboard that will happen before the end of the round are your challenges.

What is the best place you may take at the end?

More formally, $*n*$ people are participating (including yourself). For any problem, if it was solved by exactly $*k*$ people at the end of the round, the maximum score for this problem is defined as:

1. If $*n* < 2*k* ≤ 2*n*$, then the maximum possible score is $500$;
2. If $*n* < 4*k* ≤ 2*n*$, then the maximum possible score is $1000$;
3. If $*n* < 8*k* ≤ 2*n*$, then the maximum possible score is $1500$;
4. If $*n* < 16*k* ≤ 2*n*$, then the maximum possible score is $2000$;
5. If $*n* < 32*k* ≤ 2*n*$, then the maximum possible score is $2500$;
6. If $32*k* ≤ *n*$, then the maximum possible score is $3000$.

Let the maximum possible score for some problem be equal to $*s*$. Then a contestant who didn't manage to get it accepted (or his solution was hacked) earns $0$ points for this problem. If he got the the solution accepted $*t*$ minutes after the beginning of the round (and his solution wasn't hacked), he earns ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/689634d4bcdc13e7ce6420b9887217d797ff92f0.png) points for this problem.

The overall score of a participant is equal to the sum of points he earns for each problem plus $100$ points for each successful hack (only you make hacks).

The resulting place you get is equal to one plus the number of participants who's overall score is strictly greater than yours.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$) — the number of participants. You are the participant number $1$.

Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains three integers $*a*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$. Here $*a*_{*i*} = 0$ means that the participant number $*i*$ didn't manage to accept first problem. If $1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 120$, then the participant number $*i*$ got the first problem accepted $*a*_{*i*}$ minutes after the start of the contest and you cannot hack this solution. Finally, $- 120 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤  - 1$ means that the participant number $*i*$ got the first problem accepted $- *a*_{*i*}$ minutes after the start of the contest and you can hack this solution. Similarly, $*b*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$ provide the information regarding second and third problems in the same format.

It's guaranteed that integers $*a*_{1}$, $*b*_{1}$ and $*c*_{1}$ are non-negative.

## Output

Print the only integer — the best place you can take at the end of the round.

## Note

Consider the first sample. If you do not hack any solutions, you will win the contest (scoreboard to the left). However, if you hack the solution of the first problem of the third participant (the only one you can hack), the maximum score for the first problem will change and you will finish second (scoreboard to the right).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ce05ace6139417da4eef9e09ebe9ab89fc70b576.png)
statementZhMd:
考虑一场包含三道题目并采用动态计分的常规 Codeforces 比赛。

现在给出一份接近最终结果的记分板。对于每位参赛者（包括你自己），都给出了他解决每道题时通过提交的时间。此外，对于你已经知道的每个解法，你也知道自己是否能够 Hack 它。在比赛结束前，记分板唯一可能发生的变化就是你的挑战操作。

你在比赛结束时最好能取得第几名？

更正式地，比赛共有 $*n*$ 名参赛者（包括你自己）。对于任意一道题，如果在比赛结束时恰好有 $*k*$ 名参赛者解决了它，则该题的最高分定义如下：

1. 如果 $*n* < 2*k* ≤ 2*n*$，则该题的最高分为 $500$；
2. 如果 $*n* < 4*k* ≤ 2*n*$，则该题的最高分为 $1000$；
3. 如果 $*n* < 8*k* ≤ 2*n*$，则该题的最高分为 $1500$；
4. 如果 $*n* < 16*k* ≤ 2*n*$，则该题的最高分为 $2000$；
5. 如果 $*n* < 32*k* ≤ 2*n*$，则该题的最高分为 $2500$；
6. 如果 $32*k* ≤ *n*$，则该题的最高分为 $3000$。

设某道题的最高分为 $*s*$。如果一名参赛者没有成功通过这道题（或他的解法被 Hack），则他在这道题上获得 $0$ 分。如果他在比赛开始 $*t*$ 分钟后通过了这道题（且他的解法没有被 Hack），则他在这道题上获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/689634d4bcdc13e7ce6420b9887217d797ff92f0.png) 分。

参赛者的总分等于他在每道题上获得的分数之和，再加上每次成功 Hack 获得的 $100$ 分（只有你会进行 Hack）。

你的最终名次等于总分严格高于你的参赛者人数加一。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$）——参赛者人数。你是 1 号参赛者。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$、$*b*_{*i*}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*}$。如果 $*a*_{*i*}=0$，则表示 $i$ 号参赛者没有成功通过第一题。如果 $1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 120$，则表示 $i$ 号参赛者在比赛开始 $*a*_{*i*}$ 分钟后通过了第一题，并且你无法 Hack 这个解法。最后，$- 120 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤  - 1$ 表示 $i$ 号参赛者在比赛开始 $- *a*_{*i*}$ 分钟后通过了第一题，并且你可以 Hack 这个解法。$*b*_{*i*}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*}$ 的含义与此相同，分别表示第二题和第三题的信息。

保证整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*b*_{1}$ 和 $*c*_{1}$ 均为非负数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——你在比赛结束时能够取得的最好名次。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。如果你不 Hack 任何解法，你将赢得比赛（左侧的记分板）。但是，如果你 Hack 了第三位参赛者第一题的解法（这是唯一一个你可以 Hack 的解法），第一题的最高分将发生变化，你将获得第二名（右侧的记分板）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ce05ace6139417da4eef9e09ebe9ab89fc70b576.png)
